plainText:
The iTunes Store is a digital distribution service owned and operated by , and is the official app store for the and operating systems. The service sells apps, books, music, movies, and TV shows, although these are all accessed in different ways depending on the user's operating system.

==Games & apps==
The launched on July 10, 2008, in time for the release of the the next day. It is the official app store for the iOS and iPadOS operating systems and as of May 2020, it had 1,847,000 apps available for download. The App Store is accessed through a dedicated app on the , or or via previews on Apple's website. As of April 2020, the App Store is available in 175 countries and regions around the world. 

===Available Pokémon games & apps===
 

==Movies & TV==
Movies first appeared for rental, and later purchase, on the iTunes Store in 2008. It is possible to purchase and rent movies and TV shows through the iTunes Store in many countries around the world. Movies and TV shows are accessible through the iTunes Store app on iOS and iPad OS; the on and or older systems; the on , devices and certain smart TVs; or as a preview on the Apple website.

==Music==
The iTunes Music Store was launched by at the 2003, In response to the decline in music sales and the rise of streaming services like Spotify, the subscription service was launched on June 30, 2015, which as of April 2020, is available in 167 countries and regions.
